scope.profile: Decoded straight ACIS edge; parser-fed SAB 21800 rooted edge also exercised
scope.public_api: drw_evaluateAcisStraightEdge maps a normalized topological endpoint fraction to the raw line parameter interval.
scope.fraction_policy: Only finite fractions in [0,1] are accepted; 0 follows the edge start vertex and 1 its end vertex.
scope.endpoint_policy: Both endpoints must be present, finite, and within the explicit finite nonnegative endpointCurveTolerance of the supporting line.
scope.interpolation_policy: Uses fused multiply-add when the parameter difference is representable and a weighted convex combination for overflowing opposite-sign differences.
scope.refusal_policy: Invalid fraction/tolerance/endpoints/curve or unrepresentable result returns false without changing point.
non_claims: B-rep validity or native/independent semantic qualification
